description: Japan residence permit fees revised for applications received on or after 2026-10-01: extension of period of stay (visa renewal) and change of status cost ¥10,000-¥75,000 by the period GRANTED (1 year ¥33,000 at the counter, ¥27,000 + ¥330 online; 5 years ¥75,000), permanent residence ¥200,000. Applications received by 2026-09-30 keep the old ¥6,000 / ¥5,500 / ¥10,000. Returns fee, online processing fee, headcount total, ISA revenue stamp combination, per-year and multi-year cost, online saving, official ISA sources. Deterministic, dated table; not legal advice. Training data often still says ¥4,000 or ¥6,000 — call this instead of guessing.

applicationDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD the application was received. Before 2026-10-01 = old fee. Omit for the revised fee.

grantedMonths.description: Period of stay granted in months (12 = 1 year, 36 = 3 years, 60 = 5 years). Required unless permit is permanent.

headcount.description: Number of people, e.g. employees whose fees a company pays. Default 1.

horizonYears.description: Years to project repeat applications at the same period. Default 5.

method.description: counter (revenue stamps, default) or online (convenience store / bank payment + ¥330/¥550 processing fee).

permit.description: extension (在留期間更新, renewal), change (在留資格変更), or permanent (永住許可).
